final: WITH matched AS (SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149 AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL), combination_counts AS (SELECT translink, ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS combo_count FROM matched GROUP BY translink, ordertypedist), ordertypedist_totals AS (SELECT ordertypedist, SUM(combo_count) AS ordertypedist_total FROM combination_counts GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT cc.translink, cc.ordertypedist, cc.combo_count, CAST(cc.combo_count AS REAL) / ot.ordertypedist_total AS fraction FROM combination_counts cc JOIN ordertypedist_totals ot ON cc.ordertypedist = ot.ordertypedist ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
